A.notes: Site A is a functional, clean execution with a literal interpretation of the building architecture. The scroll animations (coloring the building, sun rising) add some interest but feel a bit disconnected from the overall flow. It passes all accessibility checks flawlessly.

B.notes: Site B presents a gorgeous, cohesive vision that perfectly captures the boutique heritage feel. The opening door sequence on scroll is a masterful touch that directly ties into the concept. Unfortunately, it suffers from contrast failures (likely the white text on the terracotta footer or small gray text), triggering a hard gate failure.

raw.why: Site B is a significantly better design in every visual and conceptual aspect, but it fails a hard accessibility gate (contrast), leaving Site A as the winner by default for delivering a fully compliant, bug-free build.
